elements.label: Aircraft positions
elements.rationale: Contains timestamped event records with numeric measures (position, altitude, speed) and aircraft attributes, typical of a fact table holding transactional observations.
elements.description: Records of aircraft position observations captured from ADS-B data feeds, including geographic coordinates, altitude, speed, heading, and aircraft identification details for each timestamped event.

elements.label: Earthquake events
elements.rationale: Contains event-level measures (magnitude, depth, felt reports) and timestamps for discrete earthquake occurrences sourced from USGS.
elements.description: Records of individual earthquake events detected by USGS, capturing when and where each quake occurred along with its magnitude, depth, and impact indicators.

elements.label: Fire detections
elements.rationale: Table holds 53k event rows with measures (brightness, radiative power) and dimensional attributes (time, location, satellite) typical of a fact table.
elements.description: Records of individual fire detection events captured by satellite, including location, time, and intensity measurements such as brightness temperature and radiative power.

elements.label: Vessel positions
elements.rationale: Contains 12.2M event rows with timestamps, geographic coordinates, and measures typical of a transactional fact table.
elements.description: Records of vessel position observations (AIS data) capturing location, speed, heading, and vessel details at specific times. Each row represents a single position report transmitted by a vessel.

elements.label: Vessel static reports
elements.rationale: 4.6 million rows of timestamped vessel events with numeric measures (coordinates, dimensions) and categorical attributes, typical of a transactional fact table.
elements.description: Event-level records of vessel observations from AIS data streams, capturing vessel identity, geographic position, physical dimensions, and timestamps for maritime tracking and analysis.

elements.label: Weather events
elements.rationale: Contains event-level records with timestamps, categorical dimensions, and geographic attributes typical of a fact table holding discrete occurrences.
elements.description: Records of weather events such as warnings and alerts reported by external providers, including when and where they occurred, their severity, and the areas affected.
